# Ember Moose

> The personal portfolio of Bogdan Janjić: developer, game creator, systems tinkerer.
> Site: https://bogdanjanjic04.github.io

# Identity

Bogdan Janjić is a final-year Applied IT student at Akademija strukovnih studija Zapadna Srbija, Užice, Serbia. Graduating late 2026. Online handle: ToShamara. Open to software development work including internships and more advanced roles.

# Projects

- ANTE ZERO: dark 3D card-table duel, playable in browser. https://toshamara.itch.io/ante-zero
- Pillars of Control: social strategy game, four competing roles, in development.
- CampaignForge: offline desktop toolkit for tabletop RPG game masters. C#/.NET 8/WPF/SQLite.
- AkademskiPratilac: Android study tracker with foreground-service timer. Kotlin/Jetpack Compose/Firebase.
- Graditelj Navika: Android habit builder. Kotlin/Compose/Hilt/Firebase. https://github.com/bogdanjanjic04/graditelj-navika
- PassPolish: Polish-notation password-strength evaluator.
- ScreenWatcher: MediaProjection pixel-change watcher. MIT. https://github.com/bogdanjanjic04/ScreenWatcher
- KinetiDebt: fitness debt tracker with PayPal/crypto verification.
- headless-samp: protocol-only SA-MP client via curses terminal. https://github.com/bogdanjanjic04/headless-samp-tui

# Areas of work

- Application development: C#/.NET, WPF, Dapper, SQLite.
- Android: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Firebase, Firestore, Room.
- Game development: Godot, GDScript, custom game-logic systems.
- Systems & Linux: Arch Linux, Bash, Wine, Python, networking, MinGW.
- AI & local tooling: Ollama, GGUF models, Claude Code, Docker-based inference.
- Modding & reverse engineering: SMAPI, Stardew Valley, reflection, XNB, save repair.

# Blog

- "Porting Chat Commands to Stardew Valley 1.6": SMAPI reflection fix. https://bogdanjanjic04.github.io/blog/chat-commands-smapi-commandmanager-reflection/
- "Recovering seeds from the SA-MP server RNG": reverse engineering and seed recovery tooling. https://bogdanjanjic04.github.io/blog/samp-server-rng-seed-recovery/

# Modding

- RenameAnimal: SMAPI mod for renaming animals, quote-aware parsing, GMCM keybinds.
- Chat Commands: run console commands from in-game chat, ported to SDV 1.6 via reflection. https://github.com/bogdanjanjic04/ChatCommands
- Serbian localization pipeline: Ollama-powered JSON localization into Serbian Latin.

# Lab

- Local LLM workbench: Ollama/GGUF model workflows, custom templates, Docker setups, mmap patching.
- SA-MP RNG research: reverse engineering, seed recovery in Python/C, validation harness.
- Linux systems tools: system-monitor, log-analyzer, health-checker on GitHub.
- Papers & analysis: steganography, air-quality data analysis, Raspberry Pi overview.
- Media & graphics: video processing, GIF experiments, 2D-to-3D rendering, pixel art.
